neh-2-11.anchor: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

neh-3-6.anchor: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

neh-5-6.anchor: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

neh-7-66.anchor: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

neh-7-68.anchor: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

neh-9-18.anchor: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

neh-9-36.anchor: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

neh-10-30.anchor: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

neh-10-35.anchor: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:

neh-12-40.anchor: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
